Celine is pleased to unveil the Celine Ateliers, an exclusive chapter of its savoir-faire.

Instilled with the French spirit of the house, Celine leather goods collection embodies our commitment to excellence.

Since the 1960s, Celine ateliers have continued to embrace this legacy with the same expertise and dedication. 

A symbol of this heritage, the Triomphe — originally designed by Céline Vipiana in the 1970s — has evolved while preserving its timeless essence.

description:
Celine presents Celine Maki-e, a temporary exhibition held at the French Pavilion at the Osaka-Kansai World Expo, from April 13th to May 11th. This initiative is supported by LVMH, Major Partner of the Expo.
 
Imagined as a symbolic journey, the space features reinterpretations of the iconic Triomphe logo, in a cultural exchange between Japanese artists and the house’s emblem.
 
By linking rich traditions to contemporary art forms, the the exhibition underlines the unequalled savoir-faire that lives in every creation and celebrates fifty-five years of the strong ties which unite Celine to Japan.
 
#EXPO2025
#SoshiNakamura
#HikojuMakie
#FrancePavilion
#LVMHOsaka2025
#Osaka2025

Celine Camille 16 Soft Bag

Introducing the Camille bag, the latest addition to the iconic 16 soft line.

Inspired by the Cabas 16 Soft, this hobo-shaped bag embodies the essence of the Celine spirit by offering a sophisticated look. Crafted from refined calfskin leather, it combines suppleness with a soft touch and shiny finish.

The Camille 16 Soft features the house’s gold finish iconic turnlock closure shaped like a discreet jewel, a signature detail present in the Celine 16 collection.

The Camille 16 Soft comes in two sizes, medium and small, and a variety of colors and materials.

Available in store and on celine.com starting January 30th

description:
Celine Bonnie

Introducing the new Celine Bonnie backpack for spring, designed as an elegant and relaxed alternative to the traditional handbag.

Featured in our iconic toile canvas, the Bonnie backpack joins the timeless line of leather goods in our Celine Essentials collection. The Triomphe canvas reprises the couture house's historic monogram first revealed in 1972: a link motif inspired by the chain around the Arc de Triomphe.
 
The Bonnie backpack is also crafted from smooth calfskin leather offering both suppleness and structure in other essential colors.

Available in store and on celine.com

As part of Celine Haute Parfumerie collection, the candle collection is conceived in the French Haute Parfumerie tradition of excellence. It reinterprets the themes and stylistic codes of Celine; blending the timeless elegance of a couture house with the essence of French tradition and cultural heritage. 

Within this collection, the « Palimpseste » candle stands out as a refined and evocative scent, featuring notes of gallicia rose, pear, ivy and moss.

The collection, comprised of 7 candles, is available in store and on celine.com

The most emblematic model of the 16 family is the Classique, made from black satin calfskin and natural tan calfskin leather.

description:
Celine Nino Bag

The Nino bag is made by Celine’s artisan leathermakers in the upmost traditional way. A refined, high-end supple grained calfskin leather with a soft hand and reinforcements that have been carefully studied to achieve a structured yet supple look. The Nino bag features a top handle and is embellished with the iconic Triomphe signature hardware.

Available in stores and on celine.com

description:
Celine 16 Bag

Named after 16 rue Vivienne, Celine’s address located at the Hôtel particulier Colbert de Torcy in Paris.

16 – seize is a prelude to the Celine look capturing a resolutely chic French spirit. It affirms the House's style and the pursuit of exceptional craftsmanship.

Each 16 bag is individually numbered on the back of the pocket. Selected amongst the most luxurious skins, the leather has been meticulously chosen for its balance of shine and transparency, whose unique finish is exclusive to Celine leather goods.

The most emblematic model of the 16 family is the Classique, made from black satin calfskin and natural tan calfskin leather.

Available in stores and on celine.com

description:
Celine Clara Bucket Bag
Celine Triomphe Canvas

The Triomphe canvas, part of the Celine Essentials collection, is a timeless line of leather goods for women and men.

The Triomphe canvas reprises the couture house’s historic monogram first revealed in 1972: a link motif inspired by the chain encircling the Arc de Triomphe. The Celine Triomphe canvas is made from natural cotton weave, embossed and coated in textured shades of black and ochre.

The Triomphe canvas extends to bags, small leather goods, travel kits and lifestyle objects.

Available in stores and on celine.com
